compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: For a migration-class:sweep change, task-decomposer emits an automated-sweep task whose transform descriptor (recipe rule or sg rewrite) is distinct from the broad detection query, preferring the recipe engine with agent-sweep fallback.
- dd-2: The emitted manual-verification task's done-definition requires re-running the detection query and asserting zero remaining sites, with un-automatable sites recorded as inline TODO(migration) markers enumerated in an un_automatable_sites field.
- dd-3: The same manual-verification done-definition requires the test gate to pass over modified files, so a zero detection count without a passing test gate is not treated as complete (a distinct named clause, separate from the zero-remaining-sites and un_automatable_sites clauses).

## TDD Exemption
TDD exemption: behavioral-testing-standard Rule 5 (non-executable LLM instruction file / static-asset criterion) — plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md and plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md are non-executable LLM instruction files whose behavioral correctness cannot be deterministically asserted by an executing test. Behavioral correctness is verified by task ae38-cd01-b69c-4952's structural boundary suite (tests/implementation-plan/test-sweep-pair-emission.sh), which asserts the contract markers against this artifact and goes RED when this prompt edit is reverted. testing_mode is GREEN: this task turns that RED suite GREEN.

## Implementation
Edit `plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md` to add a "Migration-Class Pair Emission" section that:
1. Adds a dispatch point keyed on migration-class (single shared dispatch point so sibling stories add CASES rather than overwrite).
2. Defines the sweep case emitting a PAIR of tasks under the two reserved namespaces: automated-sweep and manual-verification.
3. automated-sweep task: on recipe-registry match emit recipe task_type + recipe_id; else emit code task_type with the agent-sweep fallback. Final executor selection is deferred to sprint (translate-recipe-to-llm-task.sh) — do NOT re-decide executor selection in-prompt (consistent with the existing "identify the transform, not select the executor" guidance). Specify transform_descriptor DISTINCT from detection_query (detection_query is the broad symbol match; transform_descriptor is the precise rewrite — recipe rule id or sg rewrite find->replace pattern).
4. manual-verification task (AGENT-DRIVEN, code task_type, never recipe) done-definition encodes THREE distinct named clauses: (a) re-run the detection query AND assert zero remaining sites; (b) record un-automatable sites as inline TODO(migration) markers enumerated in an un_automatable_sites field; (c) the test gate must pass over the modified files (a zero detection count WITHOUT a passing test gate is NOT complete).
5. Mark db and flag-tag as RESERVED headers (reserved for sibling stories ef21 and c5fa respectively); do NOT emit them as active cases for this story.

Edit `plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md` Step 3 (task-decomposer dispatch) to pass the last-wins MIGRATION_CLASS marker as a new {migration-marker} task argument (Step 3 does not currently pass it) — add it to the dispatch's "Pass the following as task arguments" list.

Keep the change additive and backward-compatible: stories WITHOUT a MIGRATION_CLASS marker (the common case) must decompose exactly as before — the absent-marker path is inert.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] task ae38-cd01-b69c-4952's structural boundary suite goes GREEN with this edit present
  Verify: bash tests/implementation-plan/test-sweep-pair-emission.sh
- [ ] Migration-Class Pair Emission dispatch point keyed on migration-class exists
  Verify: grep -q 'Migration-Class Pair Emission' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
- [ ] Sweep case names both reserved namespaces (automated-sweep, manual-verification)
  Verify: grep -q 'automated-sweep' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md && grep -q 'manual-verification' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
- [ ] transform_descriptor specified distinct from detection_query
  Verify: grep -q 'transform_descriptor' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md && grep -q 'detection_query' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
- [ ] recipe-preferred / agent-sweep fallback encoded (recipe_id on match else agent-sweep)
  Verify: grep -q 'recipe_id' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md && grep -q 'agent-sweep' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
- [ ] manual-verification clause (b) un_automatable_sites + TODO(migration) present
  Verify: grep -q 'un_automatable_sites' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md && grep -q 'TODO(migration)' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
- [ ] db and flag-tag marked reserved (not active cases)
  Verify: grep -q 'flag-tag' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md && grep -qiE 'reserved' plugins/dso/agents/task-decomposer.md
- [ ] SKILL.md Step 3 wires {migration-marker}
  Verify: grep -q 'migration-marker' plugins/dso/skills/implementation-plan/SKILL.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
